H1.observation: Diagnostic greedy prompts repeat comma token 15 (30–32 times), token 69 (24 times), and token 165 (32 times). All evidence is open diagnostic output.
H1.hypothesis: Tied embedding/readout self-copy paths contribute to repeated-token attractors; modestly shrink the three diagnosed rows.
H1.formula: Scale rows 15,69,165 of model.embed_tokens.weight, preserving lm_head tie.
H1.prediction: May reduce repetition on known diagnostic continuations and shift sentence likelihoods; it may only replace one repeated token with another.
H1.risk: Those tokens also encode legitimate text. Tied input/output changes can harm grammar preferences and other tokens may become new attractors.

H2.observation: Every diagnostic pair with fewer good-sentence tokens is correct (286/286), every pair with more good-sentence tokens is wrong (0/309); same-length pairs are 261/429. Raw sentence scoring is strongly length dominated.
H2.hypothesis: Increase the gain of existing output evidence relative to the nearly uniform per-token penalty via the final RMSNorm scale.
H2.formula: model.norm.weight *= coefficient; logits for each fixed prefix scale uniformly. This is probability calibration, not new computation.
H2.prediction: Sentence likelihood ordering can change even though exact greedy argmax ordering should remain unchanged. Any benefit is calibration of this metric, not evidence of improved free generation.
H2.risk: Overconfidence in wrong existing predictions can lower likelihood quality and pair accuracy.

H3.observation: Read-only diagnostic activation norms: mean attention output 0.052 and 0.100 versus MLP 0.034 and 0.078 in layers 0 and 1; tied-embedding greedy output often copies a token repeatedly.
H3.hypothesis: Strengthen existing last-layer contextual attention relative to the residual token self-copy path.
H3.formula: model.layers.1.self_attn.o_proj.weight *= coefficient; no other architecture or attention rule changes.
H3.prediction: Contextual attention can change which token evidence dominates, affecting grammatical likelihood preferences and repetition.
H3.risk: Activation norms are not causal proof; strengthening an incorrect attention computation can worsen both measures.

combinations.rule: Choose singleton winner of each family by registered validation rank; try H1+H2, H2+H3 and H1+H2+H3. No new coefficient tuning.

method: Explicit formulas reasoned from diagnostic observations; no gradients, optimizer, regression, evolutionary search, or stochastic candidate search.
